title: chore: gitignore moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/ (Kotlin daemon session files raise MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED on landings)
description:
Observed 2026-10-30 at 07:33Z on two landings: V05 (102c9838) and R10d3 (5f4c6873). Each raised `MOE_ATTRIBUTION_UNRESOLVED` for `moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/kotlin-compiler-<n>.salive`. The Kotlin Gradle plugin writes those transient daemon-session files during every ./gradlew run. `git check-ignore` confirms that neither .gitignore nor moe-jetbrains/.gitignore covers `.kotlin/`, so every landing made during a Gradle build reports them as unattributed paths.

Fix: ignore the directory (e.g. `.kotlin/` in moe-jetbrains/.gitignore, which matches JetBrains' standard Kotlin ignore). Nothing under it is tracked today.
definitionOfDone: `git check-ignore moe-jetbrains/.kotlin/sessions/x.salive` reports the matching ignore rule, and no tracked file is newly ignored: `git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` prints nothing new.
The change touches only a .gitignore file.
